question: Sunlight takes an average of _________ to travel from the Sun to Earth.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 8 minutes and 20 seconds.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sunlight an average of **8 minutes and 20 seconds** to make a trip from the Sun to the Earth.
 
• **In 1729, James Bradley **found a heavenly abnormality. From this impact, he verified that light should travel multiple times quicker than the Earth in its circle (the cutting edge figure is multiple times quicker) or, proportionately, that it would require light 8 minutes 12 seconds to make a trip from the Sun to the Earth.
 
• It requires** 499.0 seconds** for light to head out from the Sun to the Earth, a distance called 1 Cosmic Unit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The speed of light** in a vacuum, usually meant c, is a general actual steady that is significant in numerous areas of material science.
 
• The speed of light c is precisely equivalent to **299,792,458 meters** each second (around 300,000 kilometres each second; 186,000 miles each second; 671 million miles each hour).
 
• All types of electromagnetic radiation, including noticeable light, travel at the speed of light.
